value.author: Laura
value.title: Beautiful stay by the beach
value.text:
We had a condo. It was amazing, very confortable. We were 2 couples. So it had 2 beautiful room with 2 complete bathrooms a huge living room and a full kitchen. We only stayed 1 night to enjoy the weekend but although we could look at the ocean it had a magnificent view of a lake you could hang out in the big terrace with a table and chair. Bed very comfortables. Super clean the whole property.
— We love the easy access to the beach and the beach service.

value.author: Sviatoslav
value.title: Отличный отель и пляж. Всем рекомендую.
value.text:
Отличное место. Очень уютный номер.(У нас был люкс)Все удобства, включая стиральную и сушильную машину. Бесплатная парковка. Отличный пляж с шезлонгами и зонтиками.
— Вентилятор на потолке в мастер спальне не работает нормально . Крутится с шумом и с дисбалансом, вследствие этого воздух над кроватью не движется.

value.author: Marilena
value.title: Great location
value.text:
We rented in apts. Very clean and nicely decorated. It has a view of the intracoastal. We could use the facilities at the beach, umbrellas chairs at no extra cost. Will be back
— The fan in main bedroom has a light that can't be turn off and the room gets a little stuffy .

value.author: Brian
value.title: We had a great time, we plan to return in September.
value.text:
We really liked the hotel in front of  the beach, the service on the beach, the restaurant was spectacular, the service in the restaurant, the taste of the food, the cleanliness of the room, everything was very good, I recommend it 100%
— They didn't put enough towels in the room, there were 4 of us and they gave us 3 towels, also on the day we left the people who cleaned the room started knocking on the door at 9:25 AM, and the check-out was at 11:00 AM then there was a knock on the door again at 10:15 AM. If departure is at 11:00 AM, you should wait until you check out with the office to start cleaning and not be bothering early.
